title: Check: Greenhouse Gases and Climate Change

questions.stem: How do greenhouse gases cause the Earth to warm up?

options.text: They block sunlight from reaching the Earth
They absorb infrared radiation re-emitted by the Earth and re-emit it back towards the surface
They react with oxygen to release heat energy
They increase the amount of sunlight that reaches the Earth

questions.explanation: Greenhouse gases absorb infrared (heat) radiation that is re-emitted from the Earth's surface, and re-emit it in all directions, including back towards the surface. This traps heat and keeps the Earth warmer than it would otherwise be. Without this effect, Earth would be about -18 degrees C instead of +15 degrees C.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a major source of methane (CH4) emissions?

options.text: Agriculture, including cattle farming and rice paddies

questions.explanation: Agriculture is a major source of methane. Cattle and other livestock produce methane during digestion, and rice paddies produce methane from waterlogged conditions. Methane is also released from landfills and natural gas leaks. Although methane is less abundant than CO2, it is about 25 times more potent as a greenhouse gas.
